# origincloud_network_internet_gateways (Data Source)

Lists the internet gateways in a region, oldest first.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose internet gateways to list.
- `region` (String) The region whose internet gateways to list.

### Read-Only

- `internet_gateways` (Attributes List) The internet gateways listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--internet_gateways))

<a id="nestedatt--internet_gateways"></a>
### Nested Schema for `internet_gateways`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) When the internet gateway was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the internet gateway, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`; empty for one the platform created.
- `name` (String) The gateway's resource name.
- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.
- `urn` (String) The gateway's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.
- `vpc` (String) The VPC the gateway connects, in the same project and region.
